Assessment.content: Clinical impression is an uncomplicated urinary tract infection (cystitis).
Assessment.source_text: I think it's, um, probably just a simple what we'd say a UTI or a cystitis, bladder infection.

Assessment.content: No concerning features such as fever or back pain reported.
Assessment.source_text: you haven't got any other symptoms that, suggest to me that there's anything to worry about, so things like fevers and back pain.

Assessment.content: Doctor believes recent cannabis use is unrelated to current symptoms.
Assessment.source_text: I, I don't think it's is related to your symptoms, I think it probably just pure pure coincidence,

Plan_of_Care.content: Start oral antibiotics for cystitis; options include trimethoprim or a 3-day course of nitrofurantoin.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: we've got a choice of two antibiotics something called Trimethoprim or, Nitrofurantoin which is a three day course.

Plan_of_Care.content: Provide a urine sample today for testing and laboratory analysis.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: It's probably worth giving us a urine sample today as well if you can, so we can send it off to the lab.

Plan_of_Care.content: Arrange practice drop-off for urine sample; test on site, send to lab, and contact patient with results.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: I will organise uh for you to come in, and drop off a sample at one of our practices, um which we can test there and then, at the urine and send it off to the lab uh we can back in touch with you with the results.

Plan_of_Care.content: Encourage hydration: drink plenty of fluids.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: make sure you're well hydrated, drink plenty of fluids.

Plan_of_Care.content: Use simple paracetamol for pain control as needed.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: If you are having some pain, simple Paracetamol, um, would probably be advisable.

Plan_of_Care.content: Select antibiotics based on urine test results if positive.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: if it is indeed positive, we'll know which antibiotics are the right ones.
I would strongly recommend you, you know, to avoid if you can.

Follow_up_Information.content: Return next week if symptoms are not improving.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: if things still are still not getting any better next week come back and see me, and we can have another look again.

Follow_up_Information.content: Call if fever, back pain, or vomiting occur.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: do bear in mind those symptoms I mentioned about the fever and the back pain and vomiting. If you have any of those give me a call, OK?
